Home.title: OpenInvites
Home.tagline: An open source, self-hostable service for event invitations.

signUp.title: Create your host account
signUp.description: Host events and share them with one link.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
forgotPassword.noMail: This instance cannot send email, so the operator resets passwords by hand.
forgotPassword.contactOperator: Contact the operator at <link>{email}</link> to reset your password.
forgotPassword.contactOperatorUnknown: Contact the operator of this instance to reset your password.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.missingToken: This reset link is not valid or has expired.

verifyEmail.verified: Thanks, your email address is confirmed.
verifyEmail.failed: This verification link is not valid or has expired. Sign in and ask for a new one from the banner on your dashboard.

banner.title: Verify your email
banner.text: We sent a link to {email}. Until you open it, you cannot create events.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with that email already exists.

errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is not valid or has expired.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.CREDENTIAL_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This account has no password to check.

dashboard.title: Your events
dashboard.empty: You have no events yet. Create one and share its link.

email.title: Email
email.label: New email
email.verificationSent: Check {email} for a link that confirms the change.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Removes your account, your events, and every guest’s data. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmDescription: Your events and every RSVP go with it. Enter your password to confirm.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email for OpenInvites
verifyEmail.body:
Hi {name},

Open the link below to confirm this is your email address. It is valid for one hour.

{url}

If you did not sign up for OpenInvites, you can ignore this message.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your OpenInvites password
resetPassword.body:
Hi {name},

Open the link below to choose a new password. It is valid for one hour.

{url}

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message and your password stays as it is.
